Transformers are a broader class of attention-based neural network architectures proposed by researchers at Google Brain. Some key points:

• They include architectures like BERT, GPT-2, XLNet, etc. 
• They have been very successful and have become the de-facto standard for many NLP tasks.

So in summary:

• BERT is a method for pre-training language representations. 
• Transformers are the attention-based neural network architectures that BERT uses.
